# CMake 项目结构与配置知识图谱

## 项目目录概览
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    R["根目录"] --> D["docs (DOS)"]
    R --> RMD["README.md"]
    R --> S["src (磐石)"]
    S --> I["include (公开头文件)"]
    S --> P["private (内部实现)"]
    R --> T["test"]
    R --> TL["tools"]
    R --> C["CMake (SIMIC) 配置"]
```

## SIMIC 列表层级与变量
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    TOP["顶层 simic list"] --> GV["全局变量"]
    TOP --> CORE["core 子列表"]
    TOP --> TEST["test 子列表"]
    TOP --> TOOL["tools 子列表"]
    CORE --> OPT["options (编译选项)"]
    CORE --> INC["include_gnu_install (安装目录变量)"]
    CORE --> CFG["config_tool (配置工具)"]
    TEST --> TGT["test 目标"]
    TOOL --> UT["导表工具"]
```

## 编译选项与构建模式
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    STD["C++20 标准 (cxx_standard)"] --> CSTD["cxx_standard = 20"]
    WARN["警告设置"] --> WARN_COMMON["-Wall -Wextra"]
    WARN --> WARN_EXTRA["extra 警告"]
    BUILD["构建类型"] --> DEBUG["Debug"]
    BUILD --> RELEASE["Release"]
    BUILD --> RELDBG["Release with Debug Info"]
    DEBUG --> DBG_SYM["-g (调试符号)"]
    RELEASE --> OPT_O2["-O2 优化"]
    RELDBG --> OPT_O2
    RELDBG --> DBG_SYM
    COMP["编译器"] --> GCC["gcc"]
    COMP --> CLANG["clang"]
    THREAD["并行编译线程数"] --> CPU["CPU 核心数"]
    THREAD --> MEM["内存/CPU 比 1:2"]
    THREAD --> CALC["线程 = CPU * 1.5"]
    CALC --> THREAD
    COVER["代码覆盖率"] --> COVER_OPT["-fprofile-arcs -ftest-coverage"]
    COVER --> COVER_OFF["默认关闭"]
```

## 代码风格命名约定
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    CONST["常量: 全部大写"] --> CONST_EX["EXAMPLE_CONSTANT"]
    CLASS["类名: 首字母大写 + 驼峰"] --> CLASS_EX["MyClass"]
    FUNC["非静态成员函数: 首字母小写 + 驼峰"] --> FUNC_EX["doSomething"]
    STATIC_FUNC["静态成员函数: 首字母大写 + 驼峰"] --> STATIC_EX["CreateInstance"]
    VAR["非静态成员变量: m_ + 小写驼峰"] --> VAR_EX["m_value"]
    STATIC_VAR["静态成员变量: s_ + 小写驼峰"] --> STATIC_VAR_EX["s_instanceCount"]
    GLOBAL["全局函数: 首字母大写 + 驼峰"] --> GLOBAL_EX["UtilityFunction"]
    LOCAL["局部变量: 小写 + 下划线"] --> LOCAL_EX["temp_value"]
```
